entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: Authentication required. Please insert your[n]member's card.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Member's card?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps it bears relation to a player's club of[n]sorts.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't handle your technical speak! Just[n]gimme it straight!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Casinos typically have a membership system[n]called a player's club.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Some locations even have areas cordoned[n]off for particular ranks of player.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering the setup of this place, I thought[n]thing may be similar here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That'll make this shit simple. C'mon, let's join[n]this player thingy.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I would agree with you, but...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: A Shadow!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As I expected. Registration will not be such a[n]simple matter.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She must be daring us to challenge the[n]security of this place to make it to her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Security Guard
entries.en: There they are! Orders say to kill on sight...!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch, here it comes!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No need to worry. I'll handle this. I need to[n]prove my worth to you, after all.
I have high expectations.
Will you be all right?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I promise to surpass even such lofty hopes[n]as those.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Who knows? I would estimate that you all[n]won't even have to step in and help though.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Phew, that is that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Impressive. It's hard to believe that was[n]really your first time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, this means we're going to have to fight[n]a ton of enemies from here on in, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Now that we know how to get in, we should[n]probably go prepare.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True... I'd like to hurry, but we don't[n]want to rush in recklessly and end up[n]losing everything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then let's get outta here for now and come[n]back when we're ready!

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: Authentication required. Please insert your[n]member's card.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems we will need a member's card in[n]order to use the elevator.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm, there is no point in wasting time here.[n]Let's hurry onward.

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: Please select your desired floor.
Go to the high limit floor
Go to the members floor
Never mind

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So if we scan that member's card, the[n]elevator should work, right?

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: Authentication complete.

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: You can now access the following floors:

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: The Standard Floor.[n]The Members Floor.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It didn't say nothing about the one for the[n]manager...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, the floors we have access to are limited[n]by player ranking.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That must mean the members floor is the[n]highest we can go for now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's impossible to mess with the data on the[n]card too. It's nothing like the ones I've seen[n]before.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So we can't go directly to the manager's[n]floor... In that case, what exactly should[n]we do?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Our first move should be to head upward.[n]Either way, we have no more business on[n]this floor.
